note: Every picture on the site. 'source' is a file in src/assets/img/source/ (a photo, or an SVG drawing). Every picture needs one of two things: 'alt', a short description that screen readers read aloud, or 'decorative': true, for a picture that is only decoration and should be passed over in silence. 'across' is how many pixel blocks wide the finished picture is: fewer means chunkier. 'shape' cuts the source to a shape (width:height) and 'crop' chooses which part: x and y from 0 to 1, and zoom. Greys darker than 'black' become solid ink and lighter than 'white' solid paper (both from 0 to 1): move them closer together for harder contrast. The rest is explained in docs/guide.md under Pictures.
